query: INSERT INTO intake.terms_acceptance (homeowner_id, conversation_id, pick_id, document, version, text_sha256, language, channel, assent_line, inbox_id, accepted_at) SELECT homeowner_id, id, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10 FROM intake.conversation WHERE id = $1 ON CONFLICT (pick_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
